messages:
marta: Supplier-Alpha flagged a partial backorder on our reserved Ampere GPUs for Q2. They say 24/72 units delayed. Need decision: bump priority or reallocate from Dedicated pool? :thinking:

alex: Do we have the vendor note? I pinged them earlier but no full ETA yet.

marta: Copy of vendor email pasted inline: 'Due to silicon shortage, shipments for PO# R-4421 will be delayed 4-6 weeks. We can expedite 12 units for priority customers if we confirm by EOD.'

priya: 4-6 weeks is rough — that'll break ramp plans for Dedicated customers. Which customers are on that PO?

marta: PO covers: Project Helix (ent A), Logarithm (mid-MRR), internal perf nodes.

sam: We have a small West-1 spare buffer we could borrow from, but that would push back internal perf tests.

jin: Sales note: Project Helix is on a committed Dedicated contract with SLA. Missing that window is high risk. Recommend expediting 12 units to them.

alex: If we expedite vendor charges ~10% expedite fee plus premium hold. Also needs a formal PO amendment.

marta: Can we negotiate a risk-share? Propose 50% expedite cost + pass-through to Helix? cc @jin

jin: Helix legal probably won't accept pass-through. I'll see if Finance can cover a one-time credit instead.

supply-bot: Vendor message: https://files.vendor-alpha.com/notes/PO-R-4421-eta.pdf

priya: Operational options if we accept expedite: 1) allocate 12 expedited units to Helix and migrate internal perf to burst hosts; 2) shift Logarithm to temporary equivalent model (14/8 quantized) with config changes; 3) delay non-SLA customers. Need allocation plan by tomorrow morning.

sam: Option 2 is doable short-term but needs config changes and will likely increase latency. Need a runbook for quick model swap and KV cache considerations.

marta: I'll draft the runbook + cost table. Alex, can you scope the PO amendment and expected expedite fee? Confirm vendor will guarantee shipment window in writing.

alex: On it. Pinged procurement and vendor contact now. ETA on a reply ~3h.

jin: Legal + Finance on standby. If we have to absorb cost, share rough numbers now so I can prep approvals. Also need a comms template for Helix if we reallocate.

marta: Decision deadline: EOD PST. If no expedite, start migration plan 2) and notify Helix.

priya: Noted. I'll start a migration checklist and tag eng-runtime for model compatibility tests. @sam please add infra blockers.

sam: Adding infra checklist. Main risk: KV cache warmup and higher tail latency on quantized path. Also GPU memory footprint differences.

alex: Vendor replied: 'Can expedite 12 units with 10% expedite fee, ship-by 2026-04-12, but require official amendment.'

marta: Decision: proceed with expedite for 12 units to Helix. @jin coordinate credits, @alex start PO amendment, @priya prep migration plan for fallback. I'll draft customer comms after Legal signs off. :thumbsup: 

jin: On it.

priya: Migration checklist will be ready by 10:30 PDT tomorrow.

sam: Will run a quick smoke test for the quantized model tonight and report failures.

marta: Logging decision in the partnerships tracker and pinging #eng-runtime for visibility. Keep all updates here.

alex: PO amendment draft for procurement: 
```
PO: R-4421-A
Expedite qty: 12
Expedite fee: 10% of line item
Ship-by: 2026-04-12
```

supply-bot: Vendor confirmation captured in procurement system, doc ID V-9982.

marta: Closing loop — thread will remain open until amendment + PRs + comms are in. Please post status updates here.
